video_title: Keyshawn Johnson Questions Lincoln Riley: All That Money, No Signature Win?

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Lincoln Riley's lack of signature wins at USC
quotes.excerpt: There's no signature win under his belt.

text_blocks.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
text_blocks.text: Part of the problem is we gave him all that money and he's been with us now five years. There's no signature win under his belt. If he had won against Utah in the Pac-12 championship the first year he got here and took us to the playoffs, he would then get more leeway. But the fact that we just spent 200 and something million dollars on a new facility and the noise about the crowd, which to me is crazy, you just get all of that negativity.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: He's got to get them to the playoffs this season. It's time to go.

quotes.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Shohei Ohtani's international star power to LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Is Ohtani a bigger international star than LeBron James?

text_blocks.speaker: Keyshawn Johnson
text_blocks.text: I guess I would ask myself, is Ohtani a bigger international star than LeBron James? I would think yes. Ohtani won two championships for the Dodgers when LeBron was not winning championships. So, you start looking at that.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: In the same city, with the chance to win a third.
